name: Beijing & Great Wall
about: Spring and fall are mild and clearest (best Great Wall visibility), summer is hot, humid and hazy, winter is cold and dry.
overview: Imperial palaces, hutong alleys, and the Great Wall within day-trip range of one of the world's largest cities.
costOverview: Subway rides and street breakfast cost almost nothing, and the major sights charge only modestly more — surprisingly affordable overall.
monthlyWeather: cold and dry, the coldest month with crisp air and occasional snow
